text:
A kitchen maid stood thigh-deep in the river one January, washing cloths with such spirit and vigor that she led a thousand fools by the nose.


A cheerful count asked her gracefully, “Are you cold?” The maid replied, “My lord, I always carry a brazier with me.”


The clever count, strutting like a peacock, asked her to light a candle he carried.


The maid raised her skirts to her backside and told him, “Then let your lordship blow this firebrand.”

translation.title: A Kitchen Maid Stood One January
